MC.title: Map Creator
MC.name: Name
MC.created: Scene "{name}" created in the Map Creator folder.
MC.paletteOf: Colors of the theme selected above. Tap a swatch to pick an exact color.
MC.hint.room: Drag on the map to draw an area. Overlapping areas join into one space.
MC.hint.open: Drag to draw floor without walls: streets, courtyards, yards.
MC.hint.cave: Paint with the brush for organic cave walls. Drag to keep painting.
MC.hint.line: Drag between grid points to draw a free wall.
MC.hint.door: Click near a straight wall to place a door.
MC.hint.window: Click near a straight wall to place a window.
MC.hint.prop: Click to place the selected prop. Choose it in the Props tab. R rotates.
MC.hint.apply: Click an area to give it the theme and wall style selected.
MC.hint.erase: Click a prop, door, window, line or area to remove it. Drag over caves.
MC.confirmClear: Remove everything drawn on this map?
MC.confirmClearAreas: Remove all rooms, open areas and caves?
MC.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}"? Maps that use it lose the prop.
MC.confirmDeleteTheme: Delete the theme "{name}" from this world? Its areas fall back to the preset.
MC.pe.title: Custom prop
MC.pe.hint: Drag to draw. For a polygon click each corner, then tap the first point or press Enter. Shapes snap to 1/8 cell.
MC.pe.imageNote: Images are drawn as they are and cannot be recolored. Use a file stored in Foundry.
MC.pe.empty: Draw at least one shape first.
MC.pe.useImage: Use an image instead of shapes
